map.工具能自动做主题提炼或开放编码吗？: Does the tool do theme extraction or open coding automatically?
map.覆盖率和主题密度分别怎么用？: How are coverage and theme density used?
map.覆盖率＝已编码条目÷总条目，用来发现漏编码的整条资料；主题密度＝总编码数÷条目数: Coverage = coded records ÷ total records, revealing whole records missed during coding; theme density = total codes ÷ records, showing the average number of tags per record. Both depend on the quality of tags entered and are unreliable when tags are missing.
map.每行首个字段为资料文本，其后逗号分隔的为主题标签；统计各主题出现频次，覆盖率 =: Each row starts with the source text followed by comma-separated theme tags. Coverage is coded entries divided by all entries. Three or more occurrences are a custom frequency cue only.
map.探索性提示：连续 5 条未出现新主题不代表研究饱和，不能单独决定停止抽样；主题提: Exploratory cue: five consecutive entries without a new theme do not establish saturation or determine when to stop sampling. Interpret themes in the context of the research design.
map.编码覆盖率 = 已编码条目 ÷ 总条目 × 100%；主题密度 = 总编码数 ÷: Coding coverage = coded entries ÷ total entries × 100%; theme density = total codes ÷ entries. Three occurrences and five consecutive entries with no new theme are exploratory cues, not evidence of saturation or a stopping rule.
map.📚 深度解析：定性资料的编码覆盖与主题频次分析: 📚 In depth: coding coverage and theme frequencies
map.用主题频次 Top10 找出高频主题；出现 3 次及以上仅为自定义频次提示，不代: Use the top 10 frequencies to identify frequent themes; three or more occurrences are a custom cue and do not establish stability.
map.分批录入资料，对比覆盖率、平均主题数和频次；连续无新主题仅为探索性提示，不能单独: Compare coverage, average theme counts and frequencies across batches. A sequence with no new theme is an exploratory cue, not a saturation or stopping decision.
map.尚未编码任何主题，无法统计连续无新主题情况。: No themes are coded, so consecutive entries without new themes cannot be counted.
map.出现≥3次的主题（自定义频次提示）: Themes appearing at least 3 times (custom frequency cue)
map.近 5 条均含主题且未出现新主题；这是探索性提示，不能判定饱和或停止抽样。: The last 5 coded entries contain no new theme. This exploratory cue does not establish saturation or determine when to stop sampling.
map.逐行录入「访谈A,价格,质量」「访谈B,价格」「访谈C,质量」「访谈D,价格,服: For seven interview entries, six are coded: coverage is 85.7%, with eight codes and 1.14 themes per entry. Two themes appear at least three times, one entry is uncoded, and the five-entry cue is not met. The tool counts entered tags; it does not extract themes.
map.不能。它只统计你已录入的主题标签的覆盖率、频次与连续无新主题情况；开放编码、主轴: No. The tool counts coverage, frequencies and consecutive entries with no new theme; open coding and theme naming require contextual judgment.
